name: new-chat-2026-10-14
source: A new, empty chat in the crow folder after the goal run of goal-run-2026-09-16.json: the start screen of the approved mockup Crow/02_docs/mockup-crow-gui-redesign-2026-10-14/Start.dc.html (Obsidian vault), as the page messages cli/crow_gui.py pushes for it (#385).
notes: Taken from the mockup: the model Qwen3.8-27B at high (default), the context 0 / 200k, the release level auto, the folder ~/Projects/crow, the rail (crow with the new chat and the goal-run chat, No folder with Latest n8n news, one archived chat), the greeting line.
Fixture, not measured: the file paths, the message counts and the clocks of the saved chats, subtask d1's record. `goal` and `at` on a rail entry are what Api._entry_of reads off the file (#385).
The rail message comes before the greeting on purpose: the start screen has to come out the same whichever of the two arrives first.
